rationale: Narrow synthetic operations corpus: every security, page/span, lifecycle and accounting assertion is mandatory. Extractive answers require complete supporting citations. Broad-domain quality is outside this release gate.

release.performance_target_hardware: CPU functional profile, 8 GiB cgroup, concurrency 1; not a production throughput claim

change_policy: Any threshold change requires a new version, rationale and comparison to this version. No silent gate relaxation.
